_comment: Describes how each checkpoint must be preprocessed at inference time.
infer.load_model() and infer.preprocess() read from here rather than from
literals in the source, which is what let training and inference drift
apart (F-01). Every new run writes an entry via train.save_checkpoint().
WARNING: the four 2023 checkpoints below were trained and evaluated with
the bugs described in potential-fixes.md (F-01 through F-10) still live.
Their `metrics` fields record what was *reported* in 2023, not what a
correct harness measures. Run `python evaluate.py --all` to fill in

metrics_reported_2023.note: Measured with BatchNorm in TRAIN mode (F-03) and with the empty-tile IoU inversion (F-08). Not a valid measurement.
